skill.name: visioncraft
skill.description: Generate and transform images or short videos through Agnes AI using PowerShell helper scripts and natural language prompts.
skill.summary: Create AI images, image edits, videos, and keyframe animations through Agnes AI.
skill.author: BAI-32

security_audit.summary: VisionCraft intentionally runs local PowerShell scripts that call Agnes AI APIs, read AGNES_API_KEY from the environment, and transmit user prompts plus optional media URLs to a third-party service. Most static findings are documentation examples, placeholder URLs, or PowerShell syntax markers, but the executable scripts do perform external network calls and handle an API secret. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed skill instructions.

remediation.issue: The skill tells users to verify AGNES_API_KEY with echo.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the echo-based verification step or replace it with a masked presence check that never prints the secret value.

remediation.issue: The scripts send prompts and image URLs to a third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: State clearly in user-facing instructions that prompts, source image URLs, and generated media metadata are transmitted to Agnes AI.

remediation.issue: Binary showcase images could not be statically inspected.
remediation.suggestion: Manually review the PNG assets before publication and replace them if metadata or content is unexpected.

content.user_title: Create Images and Videos with Agnes AI
content.value_statement: Visual generation workflows often require manual API calls and parameter setup. VisionCraft gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code guided commands for images, videos, image edits, and keyframe animation.
actual_capabilities: Generate images from text prompts through the Agnes Image API.
Transform existing images using public image URLs or data image inputs.
Generate short videos from text prompts through the Agnes Video API.
Animate one or more source images into video clips.
Create keyframe transitions between two image references.
Control common output settings such as aspect ratio, size, duration, frame rate, seed, and negative prompt.
limitations: Requires PowerShell 7 or compatible PowerShell execution.
Requires a valid Agnes AI API key stored in AGNES_API_KEY.
Sends prompts and media references to the external Agnes AI service.
Video generation can take several minutes and may need later status checks.

use_cases.title: Prototype campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Generate poster concepts, product scenes, or style variations from written creative briefs.

use_cases.title: Create motion concepts
use_cases.description: Turn a static prompt or reference image into a short video clip for storyboards or social previews.

use_cases.title: Test visual prompt ideas
use_cases.description: Run repeatable image and video prompts with explicit parameters for size, ratio, duration, and seed.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image of a calm mountain lake at sunrise in a realistic style.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle an existing image
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this image as a clean futuristic product render while preserving the object shape: https://example.com/input.png

prompt_templates.title: Create a short video
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 6 second vertical video of a delivery robot moving through a bright modern city plaza.

prompt_templates.title: Animate between keyframes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a smooth cinematic keyframe transition between these two images, keeping the same character identity: https://example.com/a.png and https://example.com/b.png

output_examples.input: Create a fantasy harbor city image at sunset.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a generated image link and summarizes the chosen size and style.

output_examples.input: Animate this product photo into a slow rotating showroom video.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a video media link after polling the Agnes AI task until completion.

output_examples.input: Make a transition from the first scene to the second scene.
output_examples.output: The skill uses keyframe mode and returns a video link for the generated transition.

best_practices: Use clear prompts that include subject, scene, style, lighting, and composition.
Use aspect ratio and duration options instead of raw size or frame values when possible.
Avoid sending private images, confidential prompts, or sensitive visual assets to the external API.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into prompts, markdown files, or command examples.
Do not request downloads of generated media unless local storage is necessary.
Do not use vague prompts when exact composition, motion, or style matters.

faq.question: What does VisionCraft generate?
faq.answer: It generates images, image edits, videos, image-to-video clips, multi-image videos, and keyframe animations.

faq.question: Which API does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Agnes AI image and video endpoints through included PowerShell scripts.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts require AGNES_API_KEY to be set in the environment before use.

faq.question: Can it use existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts public image URLs or supported data image inputs for image and video workflows.

faq.question: Are prompts kept local?
faq.answer: No. Prompts and media references are sent to Agnes AI to generate results.

faq.question: Does it work outside Claude Code?
faq.answer: The scripts can be run directly in PowerShell, but the skill guidance is designed for Claude Code workflows.
